\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 167-169 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R172-first-pass-words-from-chapters-167-169}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a magazine and a TV series.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item ice cream, chocolate, a biscuit, a soft drink, jam
  \item a website, a password, a passport, a visa, a form
  \item an adult, a classmate, a host, an enemy, people
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Ice cream? (\textbf{\fa{بستنی}}, \emph{bastani}.) Chocolate? (\textbf{\fa{شکلات}}, \emph{shokolât}.) A biscuit? (\textbf{\fa{بیسکویت}}, \emph{biskuit}.) A soft drink? (\textbf{\fa{نوشابه}}, \emph{nushâbe}.) Jam? (\textbf{\fa{مربا}}, \emph{morabbâ}.) A website? (\textbf{\fa{سایت}}, \emph{sâyt}.) A password? (\textbf{\fa{رمز}}, \emph{ramz}.) A passport? (\textbf{\fa{پاسپورت}}, \emph{pâsport}.) A visa? (\textbf{\fa{ویزا}}, \emph{vizâ}.) A form? (\textbf{\fa{فرم}}, \emph{form}.) An adult? (\textbf{\fa{بزرگسال}}, \emph{bozorgsâl}.) A classmate? (\textbf{\fa{همکلاسی}}, \emph{hamkelâsi}.) A host? (\textbf{\fa{میزبان}}, \emph{mizbân}.) An enemy? (\textbf{\fa{دشمن}}, \emph{doshman}.) People? (\textbf{\fa{مردم}}, \emph{mardom}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

(\textbf{\fa{شخصیت}}, \emph{shakhsiyat}.) A narcissus? (\textbf{\fa{نرگس}}, \emph{narges}.) A vase? (\textbf{\fa{گلدان}}, \emph{goldân}.) An animal? (\textbf{\fa{حیوان}}, \emph{heyvân}.) A rooster? (\textbf{\fa{خروس}}, \emph{khorus}.) A sparrow? (\textbf{\fa{گنجشک}}, \emph{gonjeshk}.) A camera? (\textbf{\fa{دوربین}}, \emph{durbin}.) A guitar? (\textbf{\fa{گیتار}}, \emph{gitâr}.) A novel? (\textbf{\fa{رمان}}, \emph{român}.) A magazine? (\textbf{\fa{مجله}}, \emph{majalle}.) A TV series? (\textbf{\fa{سریال}}, \emph{seriyâl}.)
